mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY change < -2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY change < -10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 2% month-over-month, it signals a sharp drop in consumer demand that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS MoM change < -2% but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals an inflationary environment that will pressure the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
